Thanks Sergio — appreciate the clear recap. A few quick notes from our side: 

- SOC 2: We are currently SOC 2 Type II-in-progress. Expect final report in late July 2027; we can share interim evidence (control matrices, attestation readiness) this month.
- HIPAA/GDPR: Medisafe is a HIPAA-covered entity; GDPR applies for EU users. We will require Business Associate Agreement (BAA) + Data Processing Addendum (DPA) before PHI processing across environments.
- Retention expectations (current internal policy): application logs (security and audit) — 13 months; backups — 24 months; deletion SLA for data subject requests — 30 calendar days for logical deletion, but full removal from backups can be negotiated (we understand enterprise needs for faster erasure).

I'll loop procurement in for contract steps (procurement@medisafe.com). Security will be copied if we need to swap artifacts — security@medisafe.com.

Hi Alice — thanks for the details and for confirming the HIPAA/GDPR coverage. Quick note from Redwood Security/Compliance: 

Default production posture (what we currently offer in-hosted/Dedicated):
- Primary application logs (audit/security events): retained 365 days by default; retained in hot storage for 90 days and archived thereafter.
- Backups (cold snapshots): retained 730 days. Backups are encrypted at rest with customer-managed keys available in Dedicated/Private plans (via KMS/HSM).
- Deletion mechanics: logical deletion from active stores within 30 days of a valid request; for backups, our standard process marks backup records for removal and they are eligible for purging at next scheduled backup retention sweep — typically within the 730-day retention window.

Enterprise options we offer (can be contracted):
- Expedited rollback/erasures with SLA of 7 business days (requires Dedicated or Private deployment + negotiated addendum).
- Shorter log retention (e.g., 90 days) where customers request and we scope impact on forensic and SLOs.
- Proof of deletion: we provide deletion confirmations and a summary of purge tasks; full forensic deletion from immutable backups requires coordinated legal/process steps.

SOC 2 timing: Redwood is targeting SOC 2 Type II completion in Q3 2027. I attached a short redwood-soc2-summary.txt that outlines scope (serving runtime, control domains) and interim artifacts we can share (control matrices, penetration test summary).

Encryption & audit notes: all data in transit and at rest is encrypted (TLS 1.2+ and AES-256), and audit logs for admin actions are retained per the log policy above. For customers who require BYOK, Private deployments support KMS integration and HSM-backed keys.

I'll be on the call Thu Jun 3 at 10:00 AM PT with Aditya to walk through any technical constraints related to deletion from KV caches and backups.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.txt

Regards,
Monica Patel
